literals.text: Note: Pay special attention to the content selected by the user. If the user asks a question or refers to the content they are looking at on-screen, they might be referring to the selected content (but they might be referring to something else that's visible, too).

presentationEvidence.scope: Recovered constructor formatting from static ARM64; not a live native-service oracle.

attributeEvidence.scope: Cache/fallback dispatch only; underlying cache, AX decoding and marker validation are not recovered.

decodingEvidence.symbolResolution: Mach-O indirect symbol table + decoded ARM64 BL immediate
decodingEvidence.limitations: Confirms type dispatch and wrapper error handling, not the complete conversion/error algorithm.

errorEvidence.limitations: Recovered enum and local branches; full error-routing algorithm and transport mapping remain incomplete.

markerDecodingEvidence.interpretation: CF type-ID guards precede forced C-reference casts; distinct Swift wrappers are dynamically cast to the requested generic type. Failed wrapper conversion constructs failedToUnwrapAttributeValue(requestedType) and forwards the throwing flag to shared failure handling. Range construction calls AXTextMarkerRangeCreate(nil,start,end) and returns its result without a local null/error branch.
markerDecodingEvidence.limitations: Static evidence only. Does not establish private C declarations, marker validation outside this branch, marker byte layout, or full typed parameter encoding. Native marker wrappers and observation integration remain unrestored.

parameterEncodingEvidence.interpretation: Typed parameterized access encodes before system read, then uses decodedThrowing for a present result. Encoding extracts marker/range references; CFRange/CGPoint/CGRect/CGSize use AXValueCreate types 4/1/3/2 and failure case failedToWrapAXValue.
parameterEncodingEvidence.limitations: Concrete marker/geometry/range branches only. UIElement wrapper extraction, generic fallback, typed attribute protocol dispatch and complete output decoding remain separate.

dynamicDispatch.interpretation: Extract raw UIElement/marker references, encode concrete AX ranges/geometry, otherwise use the Swift runtime object bridge without recursive collection traversal. AXEncodedValue.init(wrapping:) forwards to this encoder.
dynamicDispatch.limitations: UIElement/cache immutable fields are restored, but the source AX-element initializer still needs transaction-aware cache construction. This is encoding only, not generic decoding or UI acceptance.

ordinaryValueDecodingEvidence.interpretation: After specialized CF branches, dynamically cast the original object to the requested type. Failure constructs failedToUnwrapAttributeValue(requestedType) and forwards the original throwing flag to shared failure handling.
ordinaryValueDecodingEvidence.limitations: Ordinary-object branch only, not a replacement for UIElement/marker/AXValue/array dispatch or complete typed output decoding.

axValueUnpackingEvidence.limitations: Concrete AXValue unpacking only; noValue policy belongs to outer AXEncodedValue decoding.

order: noValue returns nil; other AXError uses conditional failure
axValueDecodingEvidence.scope: AXValue branch only, not the full generic decoder.

axUIElementDecodingEvidence.scope: Raw AXUIElement decoder only; generic UIElementProtocol wrapper construction is separate.

rawAttributeEvidence.limitations: Direct system-call branches only. Same-process dispatch, mock hooks and AXPartialValue metadata require further restoration.

processIdentity.interpretation: Direct actualPID path initializes Int32 output to -1, calls an indirect query wrapper, throws axError on nonzero status, otherwise returns the output. The caller encodes thrown failure as optional nil after logging.
processIdentity.limitations: MockProvider, obfuscated function resolution and log emission are not reconstructed. The inspected wrapper initialization is not evidence of a per-element PID result cache.

sameProcessScheduling.interpretation: When resolved PID equals getpid and NSThread.isMainThread is false, both direct system-read branches synchronously use DispatchQueue.main; missing/different PID or main thread stays direct.
sameProcessScheduling.limitations: Static branch and symbol evidence. PID helper failure handling and MockProvider dispatch remain separate; no per-element PID cache established.

isComplete.semantics: availableRanges == nil; count and range coverage are not inspected

valueDescriptorEvidence.limitations: Value metadata only; truncation generation and subset selection algorithms remain separate.

partialArrayEvidence.semantics: Nonthrowing array decode; nil fails, empty array succeeds; subset metadata forwarded without count/range reconciliation.
partialArrayEvidence.limitations: Underlying generic CFArray decoding and full AXPartialValue storage are not implemented by this helper.

arrayTransformEvidence.semantics: compactMap removes nil element decodes, preserving successful element order and duplicates.
arrayTransformEvidence.limitations: CFArray bridging, target protocol conformance and final array cast remain separate parts of the full decoder.

arrayTargetEvidence.limitations: Protocol, bridge and conversion evidence; the complete generic element decoder and dynamic dispatch are not yet connected.

elementStorageEvidence.interpretation: UIElement stores an AX reference plus UIElementCache. The shared initializer and cache initializer read TaskLocal context. The element initializer forwards context components or absent-context zeros to the cache construction helper.
elementStorageEvidence.limitations: TaskLocal payload semantics, cache population/invalidations and transaction lifetime are not recovered. This does not prove a process-global or per-PID cache, and an AX reference alone cannot stand in for the complete UIElement.

protocolContract.interpretation: Two inherited witness requirements plus ten direct requirements; inherited AccessibilityNode identity is AXUIElement and Role is UIElementRole. UI snapshot labels/UUIDs cannot substitute for native element identity. Extensions are not all direct protocol requirements.
protocolContract.limitations: Three remaining direct witness semantics and inherited AccessibilityNode contract still need recovery; complete action descriptor mapping is not implemented.

branches: Read cache.transactionAttributes first. If nonnil and missing target, return false without reading supportedAttributes.
If transactionAttributes is nil, read cache again; empty supportedAttributes returns false (unknown).
Otherwise read cache again and return NOT supportedAttributes.contains(target).
attributeSupport.interpretation: Missing data is not sufficient evidence that an attribute is unsupported. Preserve nil versus empty transaction set and repeated lazy cache getter calls.
attributeSupport.limitations: Recovered helper and concrete UIElement extension only; full protocol, decoder dispatch and production collector integration remain pending.

branches: Concrete witness loads cache.attributes from element offset 0x10; generic extension obtains cache through witness offset 0x28.
Empty dictionary or missing AXSubrole returns nil; neither path invokes an AX read.
Present entry passes its encoded AnyObject to specialized decoder 0x100710b44 with throwingOnFailure=false; decoder errors are swallowed and return nil.
String decoder still performs CF type dispatch before conversion; ordinary String casting alone is not a faithful replacement.
cachedSubrole.limitations: String specialization and cached concrete subrole are implemented; full generic decoder, UIElementProtocol and production collector integration remain pending.

branches: String cannot conform to UIElementProtocol or be an AXUIElement class; element target mismatch returns nil or failedToUnwrapAttributeValue(String).
Marker and marker-range wrappers cannot convert to String; preserve nil versus throwing policy.
AXValue unpacks via 0x1006ea098 before requested-type cast and AXError handling. noValue becomes nil; other AX errors honor throwingOnFailure.
CFArray target rejection is unexpectedAttributeValueType(expected: [Any], actual: String).
Ordinary objects use Foundation dynamic cast to String, with no description/stringification fallback.
stringDecoder.limitations: Concrete String specialization only. Original executable was not run; static branch evidence plus local Swift boundary tests.

branches: Read cache once via witness offset 0x28, then dictionary lookup. Empty/missing key returns nil without decoding.
Copy the complete 56-byte AXPartialValue including both descriptors; typed lookup calls AXPartialValue.decoded.
Preserve Optional<Value> nesting: a decoded some(nil) for an Optional target remains a hit, while decoder none allows the outer value(for:) fallback.
cachedValueLookup.limitations: Generic decoder is an explicit dependency; concrete String decoder is connected. Full generic decoder and production observation integration remain incomplete.

uncachedValueRead.interpretation: Known-unsupported exits before AX reference acquisition/read. Reject other status codes before examining optional data. On tolerated status, absent data returns nil; present data chooses nonthrowing decode when ignoringTypeMismatch, otherwise throwing decode. Preserve descriptors.
uncachedValueRead.limitations: Provider read and generic partial decoders remain explicit dependencies. Outer catch and concrete String composition are restored; logger backend and production integration remain separate.

uncachedValueErrorBoundary.interpretation: Success returns directly. Errors enter the logger path then return nil; reporting does not retry reading or decoding.
uncachedValueErrorBoundary.limitations: reportError is an explicit logger dependency, not a claim that original OS log category, level and formatting are restored.

cachedRole.interpretation: Read cache once; decode cached AXRole as String with throwing disabled. Non-nil string bridges into UIElementRole; missing/failed decoding uses AXUnknown. Empty and custom strings are not replaced. No uncached read or static role witness lookup.
cachedRole.limitations: Concrete UIElement getter restored; full role catalog, presentation mapping and production tree integration remain pending.

disclosurePolicy: Check AXDisclosing support against cached supported attributes when transactionAttributes is nil or includes the key; otherwise enumerate fresh supported attributes.
Only if supported, call isAttributeSettable; false or error yields no supplemental disclosure action.
Decode cached AXDisclosing with Bool specialization 0x10070fc2c; true selects collapse, false or missing selects expand.
actionWitnesses.interpretation: Action witnesses are not raw AX action-name lists. The successful native action read is combined with computed disclosure actions before description mapping.
actionWitnesses.limitations: Bool decoder, action name storage and supplemental disclosure selection are restored. Full action getter/provider wiring, remaining static actions, description mapping and array combination semantics remain pending.

boolDecoder.interpretation: Concrete Bool specialization retains CF dispatch, AXValue error interpretation and Foundation conditional Bool conversion. Do not replace dynamic casting with NSNumber.boolValue or string truthiness.
boolDecoder.limitations: Decoder only; complete action data types, description mapping and supplemental-action wiring remain pending.

actionArrayComposition.caller: 0x100790d5c saves native array; 0x100790d70 computes supplemental; 0x100790d7c appends
actionArrayComposition.semantics: Append supplemental after native actions, preserve order and duplicates at this boundary; native failure reports error and skips supplemental computation.
actionArrayComposition.limitations: Original native action reader includes separate conversion/uniquing and provider dispatch; these are not replaced by array concatenation. Original logging category/format and production action-description wiring remain pending.

systemActionReader.identityProjection: 0x1006fb4d8..0x1006fb4e4 copies String words and retains its object
systemActionReader.dependency: swift-algorithms 1.2.1 selected and pinned; original linked version is not established
systemActionReader.limitations: System branch only; original TaskLocal MockProvider selection and complete production action wiring remain pending.

systemActionDescriptionReader.statusGate: 0x1006f9934: only success continues; all other statuses throw UIElementError.axError
systemActionDescriptionReader.nilGate: 0x1006f997c; nil output remains nil, empty string remains present
systemActionDescriptionReader.limitations: System branch only. TaskLocal MockProvider dispatch, custom description resolver and production descriptor wiring remain pending. Typed CFString output follows the system API contract.

disclosureActionsImplementation.limitations: Supplemental actions only. Full actions getter, native support/settable provider wiring, remaining static actions, description mapping and array combination remain incomplete.

transactionScopeEvidence.interpretation: current is an optional tree transaction with nil initialization. perform(work:) binds the transaction using synchronous TaskLocal.withValue and forwards the supplied work closure within that scope.
transactionScopeEvidence.limitations: Does not establish transaction creation/prefetch policy, cache invalidation, role frequency algorithm or tree revision semantics. No process-global cache replacement is implied.

roleIdentity.interpretation: Role is a distinct CFString-backed value type, sharing CFString/String constructors and CF hashing with attribute keys; equality delegates to CF equality. rawValue bridges the stored string. FrequencyTable uses this role type, not display labels or attribute names.
roleIdentity.limitations: Static role constants, presentationKind mapping, role discovery and full transaction protocol remain separate.

transactionCacheEvidence.interpretation: The transaction cache contains an AX-element-keyed partial attribute table, a set of requested attributes, and a system OSAllocatedUnfairLock protecting the fallback UIElementCache dictionary.
transactionCacheEvidence.limitations: Field types alone do not prove initialization, insertion, invalidation or lock critical sections. Do not replace these with process-global caches or a guessed locking policy.

elementCacheEvidence.interpretation: The element cache holds a supported set, partial-value dictionary, and optional transaction attribute set. The constructor brackets fallback dictionary lookup with the system unfair lock; the lookup returns the stored three-field value or absent result.
elementCacheEvidence.limitations: This verifies one read-side critical section, not all cache writes, initialization, invalidation or native observation behavior. Optional transactionAttributes must not be collapsed to an empty set.

fallbackWrite.interpretation: Fallback lookup and storage use separate lock regions. The storage call passes nil for transactionAttributes. The dictionary setter replaces an existing three-field cache value or inserts a new key; it does not keep the first concurrent value by double-checking.
fallbackWrite.limitations: Does not recover the full attributes collection pipeline, every error path or all cache writers. No process-wide cache or single-flight guarantee follows.

prefetchedHit.interpretation: A transaction table hit returns a cache whose supported set comes from the stored attribute dictionary keys; attributes and requested transaction set are retained. An empty per-element dictionary is a hit, not a fallback. Requested attributes are neither synthesized into the data nor used to filter existing keys.
prefetchedHit.limitations: The extracted helper returns nil on a miss; full construction must still follow the separate locked fallback and attribute collection paths. It does not implement TaskLocal or transaction prefetch creation.

coldConstruction.interpretation: Cold collection reads supported names, constructs a set, and combines it with a 20-attribute base set before additional policy and insertion passes. Batch failure returns an empty attribute dictionary with supported names retained and skips fallback cache insertion; successful batch or empty request may enter the fallback write path when transaction storage exists.
coldConstruction.limitations: The base set is not the final request list. Selection is further decoded in coldSelectionPolicy; process identity acquisition, MockProvider, set traversal ordering and full construction remain separate.

coldSelectionPolicy.interpretation: Start with supported/base intersection; insert supported DOM class list only on exact bundle identifier match. Insert every supported visible and selected group member. Identity lookup is guarded by DOM attribute support. The helper at 0x1006ed930 inserts, returning true for new membership and false for existing membership; it does not remove.
coldSelectionPolicy.correction: Earlier coldConstruction notes called these later passes removal; instruction follow-through proves insertion.
coldSelectionPolicy.limitations: Selection helper accepts an identity resolver; original provider/system identity acquisition and full transaction construction are not implemented by it.

attributeNamesEvidence.interpretation: Direct system enumeration initializes output to nil, calls AXUIElementCopyAttributeNames, and discards its return status before consuming the output. PID/thread dispatch mirrors the ordinary attribute reader.
attributeNamesEvidence.limitations: The restored raw adapter does not implement MockProvider override, CF-array bridging, UIElementAttribute conversion or production cache assembly.

arrayBridge.interpretation: Conditionally bridge NSArray to the whole [CFString] array with Foundation, default to empty on missing bridge output, then preserve order during wrapper conversion. This is not compactMap or CFGetTypeID filtering.

attributeKey.interpretation: UIElementAttribute stores one CFString. String initialization bridges through Foundation; CFString initialization forwards the reference. Equality and hashing delegate to CoreFoundation _CFObject conformances.
attributeKey.limitations: This restores the key core and ordered name wrapping, not the full static attribute constant catalog, AppKit-specific overloads, MockProvider override or complete cache construction.

encodedStorageEvidence.interpretation: Encoded storage holds an immutable AnyObject; partial storage holds three immutable fields. valueIsString compares CF type IDs. The public wrapping initializer calls the separate parameter encoder.
encodedStorageEvidence.limitations: Storage memberwise construction is not a replacement for init(wrapping: Any), generic unwrapping, truncation generation or the full cache pipeline.

multipleAttributeEvidence.interpretation: Raw system failure discards the output array; success requires a non-nil AnyObject array for mapping. Mapping indexes each requested attribute, retains NSNull and ordinary objects, keeps AXError success/noValue/attributeUnsupported values, and removes the key for other AXError values. Duplicate keys are processed in order; shorter output traps and extra output is unused.
multipleAttributeEvidence.limitations: Restores the non-MockProvider system pipeline; not provider overrides, truncation generation, transaction assembly or production UI integration.

frequencyTableEvidence.interpretation: Dictionary-backed value type; missing subscript is zero, increment initializes to one or uses checked addition, isUnique requires a present count equal to one.
frequencyTableEvidence.limitations: Counter behavior only; role collection, transaction creation and cache invalidation are not reconstructed by this helper.
